subject: Math
subskill: Graph - Identify Inequality from Shaded Region
prompt: A delivery service charges a flat fee of $$8$ plus $$1.25$ per pound to ship a package. A customer wants to spend more than $$15$ but at most $$33$ on shipping. If $w$ represents the weight, in pounds, of the package, which inequality represents all possible values of $w$?
explanation: Choice A is correct. The total cost $C$ for shipping a package weighing $w$ pounds is $C = 8 + 1.25w$. The customer wants to spend more than $$15$, so $8 + 1.25w > 15$. Subtracting $8$ from both sides gives $1.25w > 7$. Dividing both sides by $1.25$ gives $w > \frac{28}{5}$. The customer also wants to spend at most $$33$, so $8 + 1.25w \leq 33$. Subtracting $8$ from both sides gives $1.25w \leq 25$. Dividing both sides by $1.25$ gives $w \leq 20$. Combining these inequalities gives $\frac{28}{5} < w \leq 20$.
